note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: Statement outerwear is doing the talking in fall layering: a viral NYC street montage (34K likes) cycles through a burgundy cropped jacket with large fur cuffs over wide-leg jeans, a long brown belted coat, a black fringed coat, and a leopard-print peplum jacket, while luxury lookbooks pile on long coats, capes, trench coats and fur accents over layered knits, with designer totes and gloves to finish.
trends.title: Statement-coat layering — fur cuffs, belted coats, leopard

trends.details: Post-Halloween living rooms settle into warm evening coziness: tufted sofas with chunky knit throws and dark green pillows, lit fireplaces under gold-framed mirrors, crystal chandeliers, candles and fairy lights, wood-burning stoves, and coffee tables styled with dried hydrangeas and eucalyptus. Slow evening tours lean into lamp and candlelight rather than seasonal kitsch.
trends.title: Cozy autumn-evening living rooms — candlelight, chandeliers, wood stoves

trends.details: Fall makeup diaries keep it wearable: affordable base routines built on gripping primer, skin tint and liquid contour, cream blush blended with a sponge, softly lined eyes and mascara — then a bolder turn for fall and winter with deep plum and burgundy eyeshadow, flushed blush, and dark glossy burgundy lips.
trends.title: Fall makeup diaries — skin tints, cream blush, plum and burgundy
